svg.text: T(n,H) mod 3 in the diagonal-law band
band H ≤ n ≤ 2H−1 colored by residue; the spine cubic W³ = W² + t generates every colored cell
spine n=⌊3H/2⌋ (first nonzero in its column)
residues from the banked exact triangle (n,H ≤ 36); every colored cell is reproduced by the digit-product formula in W (342/342)
